question_text: A local government unit plans to cut the budget for public elementary schools to fund a new infrastructure project. Under Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The LGU may cut the education budget because education is a local matter.
The state must assign the highest budgetary priority to education, so cutting the education budget is unconstitutional.
The LGU may cut the budget only if the Department of Education approves.
The Constitution does not address budget allocation for education.
